_about: Patristic and spiritual works ingested from the Christian Classics Ethereal Library (CCEL), which publishes these public-domain texts for download as ThML. Add a work here and run `npm run data:all` to ingest it. `scriptureMode` says how verse links are derived: 'tractates' / 'psalm-roman' / 'john-dot' read the work's own section titles (structure-based, strongest); 'tags' uses scripture references tagged inside the text (machine-tagged: the text cites the passage, it is not necessarily a commentary on it).

works.title: Tractates on the Gospel of John
works.author: Augustine of Hippo
works.description: Augustine's running homilies on John, including the great Eucharistic tractates 25–27 on John 6.
works.translator: Rev. John Gibb (Tractates 1–37) and Rev. James Innes (Tractates 38–124), for Dods' Series of Augustin's Works; ed. Philip Schaff, NPNF 1st series vol. 7 (1888)
works.rightsEvidence: Translators named in the volume's preface; 1880s publication.

works.title: Expositions on the Psalms
works.author: Augustine of Hippo
works.description: Augustine's commentary on the whole Psalter, in the Vulgate/Septuagint numbering that this app uses as its anchor.
works.translator: Translation largely by Rev. J. E. Tweed, with other hands; ed. Philip Schaff, NPNF 1st series vol. 8 (1888)
works.rightsEvidence: Credits as stated in the volume's editorial preface; 1880s publication.

works.title: Homilies on the Gospel of John
works.author: John Chrysostom
works.rootTitle: Homilies of St. John Chrysostom on the Gospel
works.description: Chrysostom's 88 homilies on John, delivered at Antioch.
works.translator: Rev. G. T. Stupart; ed. Philip Schaff, NPNF 1st series vol. 14 (1889)
works.rightsEvidence: Translator credited in the volume's preface; 1880s publication.

works.title: Homilies on the Gospel of Matthew
works.author: John Chrysostom
works.translator: Rev. Sir George Prevost, revised by Rev. M. B. Riddle; ed. Philip Schaff, NPNF 1st series vol. 10 (1888)
works.rightsEvidence: Translator credited in the volume's preface; 1880s publication.

works.title: On the Incarnation
works.author: Athanasius of Alexandria
works.description: Athanasius on why the Word became flesh.
works.translator: Translation as printed in NPNF 2nd series vol. 4 (1892), special editor Archibald Robertson
works.rightsEvidence: 1890s publication; translator credit is in the printed volume.

works.title: Catechetical Lectures (incl. Mystagogical Catecheses)
works.author: Cyril of Jerusalem
works.description: Instructions for catechumens, including the Eucharistic catecheses.
works.translator: Edwin Hamilton Gifford (the Lectures, in NPNF 2nd series vol. 7, 1894)
works.rightsEvidence: Translator credited in the volume's introduction; 1890s publication.

works.title: Against Heresies
works.author: Irenaeus of Lyons
works.description: Irenaeus' defence of apostolic tradition and the unity of Scripture.
works.translator: ANF editors (Alexander Roberts, James Donaldson), with Rev. W. H. Rambaut for books 3–5; Ante-Nicene Fathers vol. 1 (1885)
works.rightsEvidence: Credits as stated in the volume's preface; 1880s publication.

works.title: Confessions
works.author: Augustine of Hippo
works.rightsEvidence: CCEL metadata: translated by E. B. Pusey; CCEL rights field: Public Domain.

works.title: The Interior Castle
works.author: Teresa of Ávila
works.description: Teresa's map of the soul's journey to union with God, as seven mansions.
works.translator: The Benedictines of Stanbrook, revised by Benedict Zimmerman, O.C.D. (London: Thomas Baker, 3rd ed., 1921)
works.rightsEvidence: CCEL rights field: Public Domain; published 1921.

works.title: The Dialogue of St. Catherine of Siena
works.author: Catherine of Siena
works.description: Catherine's dialogue with God the Father; Doctor of the Church.
works.rightsEvidence: Translation of 1896 as printed by CCEL; published before 1929.

works.title: The Practice of the Presence of God
works.author: Brother Lawrence of the Resurrection
works.description: Conversations and letters of a Carmelite lay brother (not canonized).
works.translator: Translator not stated in the CCEL record
works.rightsEvidence: CCEL rights field: Public Domain. Translation edition not identified; flagged for review.

_excluded.john-cross-dark-night: CCEL edition is E. Allison Peers' 20th-century translation; its US/EU status could not be verified, so it is not imported.
_excluded.desales-devout-life: CCEL record states no rights or translator; not imported until the translation and its date are verified.
_excluded.kempis-imitation: CCEL edition is a 1949 translation (Croft & Bolt). CCEL marks it Public Domain, but a 1949 translation is not obviously so; not imported until verified.
